title: Company registration
intro: Minimal registration at installation; complete details inside the ERP. No vendor master account.
manual: Manual entry is available. External lookup is unconfigured and disabled.
uncertain: Uncertain response: query the original attempt; no automatic resend.
fiscalNote: These details do not authorize issuance or prove homologation. Configure certificates and tokens separately.
unsaved: Unsaved data or a pending attempt remains. Leave anyway?
lostKey: Losing the master key makes secrets inaccessible. The ERP vendor cannot recover them. Generate and export your private backup at installation.
dataDestination: Choose the destination in installation configuration: local, own server or customer cloud. Selecting a connection does not migrate data or send keys to the vendor.
setupScope: This guide does not install software, read your keys or prove fiscal authorization. Data stays on the infrastructure you choose.
setupStorageHelp: Install on the customer-selected machine. The --db path selects the data file. Customer server and cloud modes require private configuration, TLS and allowed networks; inspect the mode before connecting the desktop. No automatic migration occurs.
setupKeyHelp: Run these operations only in the installation’s private terminal. The key is shown once in that terminal, never on this screen. Keep its backup separate from the vault.
setupCommandHelp: Terminal examples: replace absolute paths with your own. Initialize only a new vault. Export a backup before confirming rotation; never overwrite an existing installation.
setupRestore: To recover, use a consistent vault copy and its matching key under your control. After rotation, retain old backups with their respective keys and update private configuration to the new key. Without a matching key, the vendor cannot recover secrets.
setupSavedOnly: These states come only from the revision read from the API. Editing an unsaved form does not complete a step.
setupFocus: In your Focus account, configure the homologation issuer, A1 and CSC when required. Here, save the fiscal profile, find it in the list and store token/CSC in the vault enabled by your installation. Read the diagnosis. A present token or valid configuration does not prove Focus or SEFAZ accepted an invoice.
setupStaffHelp: Open employee management with an active module and permission. Employee records and access credentials are distinct. Do not grant ownership to unlock screens: NF-e 55 issuance remains restricted to the authorized owner.
